source_caption:
𝐘𝐄𝐋𝐋𝐎𝐖 𝐋𝐄𝐓𝐓𝐄𝐑𝐒 (𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔) is a powerful family drama about what happens when politics, art and personal freedom collide.⁣ 👀 
⁣
Derya and Aziz see their lives turned upside down after losing their jobs due to political pressure. Together with their 13-year-old daughter Ezgi, they leave Ankara for Istanbul, where they are forced to move in with Aziz’s parents and rebuild their lives from the ground up.⁣
The film premiered in competition at the Berlin International Film Festival, where Özgü Namal and Tansu Biçer received the Silver Bear for Best Leading Performance for their work as Derya and Aziz.⁣
⁣
𝐘𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐨𝐰 𝐋𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐬 (𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔), directed by İlker Çatak, is coming to Dutch cinemas, brought to you by Cinéart NL.⁣

⁣

source_details.title: Yellow Letters
source_details.synopsis: Yellow Letters (German: Gelbe Briefe) is a 2026 political drama film directed by İlker Çatak, who co-wrote the screenplay with Ayda Çatak and Enis Köstepen. It follows Derya (Özgü Namal) and Aziz (Tansu Biçer), a couple of Turkish theater artists who lose their jobs due to political persecution in Turkey. The film had its world premiere at the main competition of the 76th Berlin International Film Festival on 13 February 2026, where it won the Golden Bear. It was theatrically released in Germany by Alamode Film on 5 March.
